thread:
mia_cs: Quick heads-up — Hyperion dedicated bring-up dry run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: validate quota gating, autoscale triggers, and fallback routing. Can folks confirm readiness?
raj_se: I have the load script ready (locust). Will push to /deploy/loadtests/hyperion/ and share command.
mia_cs: great — need confirmation on quota numbers from platform side and whether autoscale max/min are set. Sam, FYI for renewal note.
sam_sales: noted. If dry run shows sustained underprovisioning we'll flag potential renewal risk to execs. Hoping to keep it green.
kevin_sre: Autoscale policy currently: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12, scale_up_threshold=70% cpu, cooldown=60s. Is hyperion expecting spikes above 12?
easly typo? ashley_infra: @kevin_sre that policy applied to the reserved pool for hyperion on us-west2. Customer requested burst to public pool if reserved exhausted. KMS/certs checked.
eva_hyperion: We expect a warm concurrency ramp to 1.2k qps for internal testing. If you need to simulate, we can hold off if it risks our production.
raj_se: Sharing the run command:
```bash
LOCUST_FILE=hyperion_workflow.py locust -f tests/$LOCUST_FILE --headless -u 500 -r 50 --run-time 10m --csv=hyperion_dryrun
```
This will simulate a scalloped ramp; we can iterate to 1200 qps.
kevin_sre: For the dry run let's start 500 -> 1200 over 20m. I'll watch autoscale events and CPU/mem. Can we add a KV-cache priming step before ramp?
mia_cs: Yes. Add priming with replay of top-200 prefixes (we have list in /s3/hyperion/priming/top200.txt).
loadbot: Scheduled load test: hyperion_dryrun starting 09:00 PT. Notifying @infra-oncall and @ops. Link: https://load.lab/hyperion_dryrun/4476543210
ashley_infra: Small note — fallback routing to hosted-model-2 requires model-variant mapping in rollout config. Raj, please confirm your load doesn't hit variant-only endpoints.
raj_se: Confirmed — tests hit /v1/generate with model=redwood-dedicated-hyperion-v1. We'll include a variant failover test at minute 12.
sam_sales: If the failover happens, capture error rates and impact to latency — that'll feed the renewal playbook. Also need a short customer-facing summary post-run.
eva_hyperion: We'll be on the call. Please capture screenshots of console heatmaps and token-level cost delta if possible.
kevin_sre: I'll dump autoscale events + pod logs and upload to /artifacts/hyperion/dryrun/4476543210/logs.tar.gz after test.
mia_cs: Checklist for tomorrow: 1) quota validated by infra (min/max), 2) autoscale policy confirmed, 3) priming run complete, 4) load script pushed, 5) rollback/fallback verified, 6) post-run notes + renewal risk assessment drafted.
ashley_infra: We're missing one thing — IAM token rotation window. If the token rotates during test, calls will fail. I'll extend rotation window by 2h around test.
raj_se: I'll instrument the test to emit request ids to trace cost/latency per request.
sam_sales: I'll prepare a one-pager for the customer in case we need to discuss contract options after results.
eva_hyperion: Appreciate it. We want the SLA to be achievable — if we need to adjust commitments, tell us after data.
mia_cs: Perfect. Final sync at 08:30 PT in #video-call. Please ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
loadbot: Reminder 30m: hyperion_dryrun in 30 minutes.
kevin_sre: I'll be monitoring; will post a live gist of metrics.
mia_cs: Thanks team — see you 08:30.
